risk_if_not_implemented: Without Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Security Solutions, applications may be built and deployed with exploitable design and coding weaknesses that adversaries can leverage. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Counterfeit / Non-Conforming Component Impact (R-SC-7), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Counterfeit / Non-Conforming Products (MT-20).

compensating_control_1.name: Statutory, Regulatory & Contractual Compliance
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the identification and implementation of relevant statutory, regulatory and contractual controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Statutory, Regulatory & Contractual Compliance (CPL-02) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Security Solutions (TDA-11.3) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Vulnerability & Patch Management Program (VPMP)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation and monitoring of risk-based vulnerability management capabilities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Vulnerability & Patch Management Program (VPMP) (VPM-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Security Solutions (TDA-11.3) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
